task: Enable the shared preview gate with the user's chosen shorter password, held only in a Worker secret.
nonGoals: Committing the chosen password, scoring changes, allowance policy changes, frontend changes or unrelated services.

outcomes.description: Preview authentication accepts configured passwords of 8 through 128 URL-safe characters and rejects incorrect or missing credentials before audit work.
outcomes.evidence: Existing auth regressions plus shorter credential boundary cases.

outcomes.description: The public release configuration requires the shared password and retains current usage admission and CPU controls.
outcomes.evidence: Independent review and post-release checks of unlock and unauthorized audit calls.

process.description: Commit plan before implementation, obtain independent review and hosted CI before releasing the requested password change.
process.evidence: Git chronology and actual command evaluation.

styleEfficiency.description: Make a targeted validation and configuration change using the existing secret binding.

exitTest.reason: Shared preview credential configuration does not change agent portability or workflow.
